episodes.title: Buffalo River
episodes.description: The Panthers Pack swims across a golden river at sunset, side by side with a herd of buffalo. When a little one gets stranded in the current, the Pack carries it to safety. "Mama! They saved me!" Next stop: Zebra Crossing. To be continued!

episodes.title: Storm Wall
episodes.description: Flash flood! A giant wall of storm clouds rolls across the plains and the Panthers Pack races through wind, rain and lightning, until they burst out into sunshine under a rainbow. "Best run ever." Season finale!

episodes.title: Rhino Fog
episodes.description: Out of the morning fog, a herd of rhinos thunders across the savanna! The Panthers Pack weaves between the giants, and one of their little friends hitches a ride on a very surprised rhino. "Who's on my back?!" Next stop: Storm Wall. To be continued!

episodes.title: Sand Avalanche
episodes.description: A 300-meter dune stands in the way! With two long-eared friends riding along, the Panthers Pack charges up the ridge as the sand starts to slide. "The ridge is quiet. Go up!" But there's thunder beyond the misty hills... Next stop: Rhino Fog. To be continued!

episodes.title: Zebra Crossing
episodes.description: Zebras on both sides! The Panthers Pack races across the open savanna as a thundering zebra herd closes in from left and right, with their tiny new friend holding on tight. Next stop: Sand Avalanche. To be continued!

episodes.title: The Moon Race
episodes.description: The moon is falling from the sky! The Panthers Pack races across the moonlit savanna to help, braving a thundering stampede along the way. With the sky in danger, they call on their star friend for one final favor: light the moon! The epic conclusion to Season 7.

episodes.title: Tiger Land Returns
episodes.description: The Panthers Pack returns to tiger territory, dodging a boar stampede through the trees! When the chase leads them to a rickety bridge, can they make it across safely? To be continued!

episodes.title: Dust Devil
episodes.description: A swirling dust devil chases the Panthers Pack across the desert! Dodging left and right through the cactus field, they pick up an unexpected running buddy: a wild boar! Can they all outrun the storm? To be continued!

episodes.title: Tidal Wave Beach
episodes.description: A day at the beach turns wild when a crab shows up and a massive tidal wave crashes over the Panthers Pack! Soaked but unstoppable, they shake it off and keep racing down the shore. To be continued!

episodes.title: Hippo Highway
episodes.description: A new adventure begins! The Panthers Pack hops across a river of hippos at sunset, with something mysterious lurking just below the surface. Along the way, they pick up a brand new friend! To be continued!

episodes.title: The Mountain of Stars
episodes.description: The Panthers Pack climbs through the snowy mountains at night, their new giraffe friend by their side. At the summit, the glowing star finally finds its way home among the stars. The end of Season 6 - Season 7 coming soon!

episodes.title: The Storm Giraffes
episodes.description: A stormy night, a lost giraffe calf, and no way to see through the rain! The Panthers Pack uses the glow of the fallen star to light the way and help reunite the calf with its herd. To be continued!

episodes.title: Canyon of Echoes
episodes.description: The Panthers Pack races through a canyon carrying their glowing star, dodging a stampede along the way! Deep in the canyon, something ancient speaks back. To be continued!

episodes.title: The River Toll
episodes.description: The Panthers Pack reaches a river crossing guarded by a toll-demanding crab! They pay their way across and press on through the savanna, the glowing star lighting their path. To be continued!

episodes.title: The Falling Star
episodes.description: A star falls from the sky right into the savanna! The Panthers Pack works together to carry the glowing star all the way to the mountain. What will they do with it? To be continued!

episodes.title: Meet the Cast
episodes.description: Meet the whole Panthers Pack crew! From the sleek Black Panther and tree-climbing Leopard to the fluffy-tailed Snow Leopard and one-of-a-kind White Tiger, every member of the pantherinae family is here. Who's your favorite? Tell us in the comments!

episodes.title: Head-On Elephant Herd
episodes.description: STOMP! The Panthers Pack has to run head-on straight through a herd of elephants! They dash right between the giant legs and make it out safely on the other side. To be continued!

episodes.title: Avalanche 2 Ice Mountain
episodes.description: RUN!!! An avalanche thunders down the mountain at 130 km/h! The Panthers Pack races through the snowy pines with their new deer friend to outrun it. They make it safely down the mountain just in time! To be continued!

episodes.title: Crocodile River Rescue
episodes.description: CROC!!! The Panthers Pack has to cross the river fast to escape a crocodile! They leap across floating lily pads at top speed and make it safely to the other side, dashing past wildebeest on the savanna. Friends forever!

episodes.title: Waterfall Splash
episodes.description: A new friend joins the Panthers Pack! A white tiger runs with the crew for the first time as they splash through a waterfall under a beautiful rainbow with their zebra and antelope friends. Best day ever!

episodes.title: Firefly Night
episodes.description: A magical moonlit run for the Panthers Pack! Fireflies light the way as the whole crew races beneath the stars before settling in for the night. No danger tonight, just pure joy under the moonlight. Sweet dreams, pack! Season 4 is coming soon.

episodes.title: Snow Day
episodes.description: Snow day for the Panthers Pack! The leopard and panther friends romp and slide through fresh powder with the whole crew, joined by their deer neighbors for a day of winter fun. No danger today, just pure joy in the snow.

episodes.title: Blossom Valley
episodes.description: Springtime in Blossom Valley! The Panthers Pack races through a valley of blooming cherry blossoms with butterflies fluttering all around. Pure spring joy with the whole pack together.

episodes.title: Splash Day
episodes.description: Splash day for the Panthers Pack! The pack takes a playful detour to the riverbank with their zebra and antelope friends, cooling off and celebrating under a beautiful rainbow. So fresh, so fun!

episodes.title: Sunrise Friends
episodes.description: A brand new day begins for the Panthers Pack! This morning there's no danger, no chase — just a joyful sunrise run alongside their zebra and antelope friends across the golden savanna. Watch the pack celebrate friendship, sunshine, and the simple happiness of a good morning together.

episodes.title: Lightning Stampede
episodes.description: Season 2 finale! A thunderstorm lights up the night sky as lightning strikes send a massive wildebeest herd into a panicked stampede, right into the pack's path. With no way out, they hold on for dear life as the chaos rages around them. Season 3 is coming soon!

episodes.title: Rockslide
episodes.description: The canyon walls give way! Boulders crash down around the pack as they race alongside a herd of antelope through the narrow rocky passage, dodging falling rocks at every turn. One wrong step could be the end. Season 2 continues!

episodes.title: Crocodile Crossing
episodes.description: The river crossing turns deadly when crocodile eyes surface in the water! The pack swims for their lives alongside a herd of antelope, with a hungry croc closing in fast. Do they make it to the far shore in time? Season 2 continues!

episodes.title: Flash Flood
episodes.description: A dry riverbed turns deadly in seconds as a flash flood bursts through! The pack scrambles for higher ground alongside a herd of antelope while a towering wall of water chases them across the plain. They make it clear — but their next crossing won't be so easy, with crocodiles waiting in the water ahead.

episodes.title: Wildfire
episodes.description: A wall of flame tears across the savanna, lit orange against the smoke-filled sky! The pack sprints alongside a herd of panicked antelope, staying just ahead of the blaze until they finally break clear to the safety of open ground. But the danger isn't over — a flash flood is already building on the horizon.

episodes.title: Crossfire
episodes.description: Running full speed through the savanna, the pack finds itself on a dead-on collision course with a charging buffalo herd! A chaotic crossfire of dust and horns later, they somehow made it out!

episodes.title: Sandstorm
episodes.description: A blinding sandstorm rolls across the desert, forcing the pack into a near-blind sprint through a cactus field, dodging a herd of fleeing rhinos and wildebeest doing the same!

episodes.title: The Great Migration
episodes.description: The season finale! The pack joins a thundering stampede of zebras and wildebeest at full speed across the open plains, then dodges a 2.3-ton white rhino charging the wrong way through the herd! After every chase this season, the Panthers Pack finally reaches safety together. Thank you for watching Season 1 — Season 2 is coming soon!

episodes.title: Avalanche
episodes.description: RUN! A thunderous avalanche breaks loose on the snowy mountainside, and the panthers sprint for their lives alongside a terrified herd of deer. One wrong step means being buried in snow!

episodes.title: Elephant Charge
episodes.description: A furious 6-ton elephant charges the pack at 40 km/h through the savanna! The panthers sprint alongside a startled herd of zebras, dodging trees and tusks until they finally shake the giant off.

episodes.title: Buffalo Stampede
episodes.description: The pack closes in on a buffalo herd at sunrise, but the hunt turns chaotic fast! Caught in the middle of a thundering stampede, the panthers weave and dodge between massive horns and pounding hooves to make it out alive.
